integration_goal.primary_goal: Integrate existing spectral analysis and graph analysis components with new onset detection and MIDI generation components to create an end-to-end audio-to-MIDI transcription pipeline
integration_goal.scope: Convert WAV audio files to MIDI format using graph-based analysis of harmonic and temporal relationships
integration_goal.success_definition: User can run a single command to transcribe a WAV file to MIDI with reasonable accuracy (>60% note detection for polyphonic music)

capability_1.name: Audio File Input Processing
capability_1.description: Accept and process WAV audio files of various formats
requirements: Handle files up to 30 minutes duration
Optionally convert other formats (MP3, FLAC) to WAV

capability_2.name: Spectral Decomposition
requirements: Perform Fourier-like analysis with musical note resolution
Sample at musically meaningful intervals (~182ms per sample)

capability_3.name: Audio Graph Construction
capability_3.description: Build NetworkX graph representing audio relationships
requirements: Create nodes for frequency-time-intensity points above threshold
Add temporal edges (same frequency across time)
Add harmonic edges (harmonically-related frequencies at same time)
Calculate meaningful edge weights (correlation, harmonic strength)
Support graph queries by time and frequency

capability_4.name: Harmonic Filtering & Fundamental Detection
capability_4.description: Separate fundamental frequencies from harmonics using community detection
requirements: Apply Louvain community detection to harmonic subgraphs
Identify fundamental frequency in each community
Filter noise based on intensity, confidence, and duration
Generate timeline of detected fundamental notes

capability_5.name: Note Onset Detection
capability_5.description: Identify when notes start vs. when they are sustained
requirements: Calculate intensity derivatives across temporal edges

capability_6.name: MIDI File Generation
capability_6.description: Convert detected notes and timings to standard MIDI format
requirements: Generate valid MIDI Type 0 or Type 1 files
Add note on/off events with correct timing

capability_7.name: Pipeline Orchestration
capability_7.description: Provide user-friendly CLI for end-to-end transcription
requirements: Single command execution: transcribe INPUT.wav OUTPUT.mid

data_contract.input: NetworkX MultiDiGraph with nodes (frequency, time, intensity) and edges (temporal, harmonic)
Timeline of fundamental notes with confidence scores
data_contract.format: List[Dict] with keys: node_id, frequency, note, intensity, time_seconds, confidence

interaction_4.note: onset_detector needs both fundamentals AND graph for flow analysis

data_contract.input: List of note events with onset times, durations, and velocities
data_contract.format: List[Dict] with keys: note_name, midi_note, onset_time_seconds, duration_seconds, velocity

data_contract.error_handling: Catches and reports errors from each component

performance.processing_speed: < 3x audio duration (e.g., 3-minute file processed in < 9 minutes)
performance.memory_usage: < 500MB for 3-minute file, linear scaling with duration

reliability.error_handling: Graceful degradation with helpful error messages
reliability.recovery: No partial state - either success or clean failure
reliability.robustness: Handle noisy audio, multiple instruments, variable quality

usability.documentation: README with usage examples and parameter descriptions
usability.feedback: Progress bar or status updates for files > 1 minute

maintainability.documentation: Docstrings for all classes and public methods
maintainability.type_hints: Type annotations for better IDE support

functional_success.criterion_1: Successfully transcribe single-instrument piano recordings with >80% note accuracy
functional_success.criterion_2: Successfully transcribe polyphonic music (2-3 instruments) with >60% note accuracy
functional_success.criterion_3: Generate valid, playable MIDI files that preserve musical intent
functional_success.criterion_4: Detect note onsets within 50ms of ground truth

non_functional_success.criterion_1: User can install and run tool in < 10 minutes
non_functional_success.criterion_2: Clear error messages help user debug issues
non_functional_success.criterion_3: Memory usage stays under 500MB for typical files
non_functional_success.criterion_4: Code is maintainable with > 70% test coverage

integration_success.criterion_1: All components can be imported and instantiated without errors
integration_success.criterion_2: Data flows cleanly from component to component
integration_success.criterion_4: Each component can be tested independently
integration_success.criterion_5: Pipeline orchestrator successfully coordinates all components

technical_constraints.no_ml_dependencies: No TensorFlow, PyTorch, or other ML frameworks (by design)

architectural_constraints.pipeline_pattern: Linear data flow: Input → Processing → Analysis → Output
architectural_constraints.stateless_components: Components don't maintain state between invocations
architectural_constraints.graph_based_analysis: Core analysis uses NetworkX graph algorithms

resource_constraints.disk_space: Minimal (only MIDI output, no intermediate files)
resource_constraints.cpu_cores: Single-threaded for MVP (parallel processing future enhancement)
